title: Privacy Policy & Terms
intro: Amsterdam Boat Tours ("we," "our," or "us") operates amsterdam-boat-cruise.com as an independent information and comparison guide for travelers visiting Amsterdam and looking to book canal cruise tours.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are & Affiliate Disclosure
sections.content: Amsterdam Boat Tours is an independent travel portal and affiliate publisher. We are not an official boat cruise operator, transport provider, or direct merchant. We partner with licensed ticketing and tour platforms (including GetYourGuide) to provide ticket comparison, schedules, and online booking links. When you click on a tour link and make a purchase on a partner platform, we may earn an affiliate commission at no additional cost to you.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content: When you visit our site, we do not require you to create a customer account or provide payment card numbers. All booking transactions, ticket issuances, and payments are processed directly by our authorized ticketing partners under their respective terms and privacy policies. If you contact us via our contact form or email, we collect your name, email address, and the content of your inquiry solely to respond to your support request.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: We use standard cookies and lightweight web analytics to understand website traffic, popular cruise options, and ensure site functionality. These cookies do not store personally identifiable financial details. You can disable or manage cookies through your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Links & Bookings
sections.content: Our website contains links to third-party booking platforms and travel service providers. Once you navigate away from our domain to an external booking provider, your interactions are governed by that third party's privacy policy and terms of service. We encourage you to review their terms before completing transactions.

sections.heading: 5. GDPR & User Rights
sections.content: If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA) or the UK, you have rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), including the right to request access to, rectification of, or deletion of any personal data we hold (such as email messages sent to us). To exercise these rights, please reach out through our Contact page.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or our affiliate practices, you can contact us via our Contact form or email at support@amsterdam-boat-tours.com.
